//hooks: MessageDisplay prepends [HH:MM] to each assistant message — display-only (screen), zero tokens, transcript untouched.
//switchModelsOnFlag: false = do NOT auto-switch on a flagged Fable 5.1 request (biology -> Opus 5, cyber -> Opus 4.8; category-based since 2.1.219). Pause with choice (switch, or edit+retry on Fable) instead of silent switch. Same as /config -> Model & output -> 'Switch models when a message is flagged' off.
//model: fable[1m] = alias `fable` -> latest Fable = Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`) since CC 2.1.255 (was Fable 5); pin the full ID if determinism matters. 1M native on Anthropic API — `[1m]` redundant but documented; CLI migrates saved Fable IDs to this form. Credit-billed $10/$50 (cache read $0.25); `-p` bills with no consent prompt. Not the account default on any plan — explicit choice. Opus 5 (subscription-included, ~Fable-5 class at half price) via `/model opus` when credits matter. Requires CC >= 2.1.255. Verified 2026-09-02.
//effort: `high` = Fable 5.1 vendor default in API and Claude Code (Tier A: start high; lower effort incl. low often exceeds the xhigh/max of previous models; launch page: similar-or-better than Fable 5 at lower cost, medium roughly matches Fable 5; xhigh/max for the most capability-sensitive work; higher effort over-deliberates on routine work). Previous global xhigh was an Opus 4.7/4.8-era opt-up; on credit-billed Fable it is paid over-deliberation. Escalate per task: `/effort xhigh`, `claude --effort xhigh`, `ultrathink`; `max` is session-only unless `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`. Per-model override exists: `modelSettings.<id>.effortLevel`. No effort hold on Fable 5.1, so this key applies directly. fastMode deliberately UNSET: fast mode is Opus 5/4.8-only and `/fast` on a Fable session switches the model to Opus 5. `alwaysThinkingEnabled` is inert on Fable 5.1 (thinking always on) — kept for Opus 4.8 fallback sessions.
